summary.text: Deborah Klein Lopez is the Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 42 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was elected to the Agoura Hills City Council in 2018, has served as mayor, and is currently mayor pro tem.

paragraphs.text: Klein Lopez graduated from Agoura High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Northwestern University.
In the survey, she said she is running in the community where she grew up and raised her children, led a ballot measure that secured funding for local public schools, and chairs Clean Power Alliance.
She said she was elected two days before the Woolsey Fire.
Klein Lopez listed her campaign messages in the survey as addressing wildfire threats, expanding access to affordable health care, and tackling the rising cost of living.
